proof_body:
by
  intro L M _ κ h1 h2
  constructor
  · intro hM h3
    obtain ⟨N, hN, hc⟩ := FirstOrder.Language.exists_elementaryEmbedding_card_eq_of_le L M κ h1 (by simpa using h2) (by simpa using h3)
    exact ⟨N, N.str, hN, hc⟩
  · intro hM h3
    obtain ⟨N, hN, hc⟩ := FirstOrder.Language.exists_elementaryEmbedding_card_eq_of_ge L M κ (by simpa using h2) (by simpa using h3)
    exact ⟨N, N.str, hN, hc⟩
target_source: ∀ (L : FirstOrder.Language.{0, 0}) (M : Type) [L.Structure M] (κ : Cardinal.{0}), Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ → L.card ≤ κ → (Nonempty M → κ ≤ Cardinal.mk M → ∃ (N : Type) (_ : L.Structure N), Nonempty (L.ElementaryEmbedding N M) ∧ Cardinal.mk N = κ) ∧ (Infinite M → Cardinal.mk M ≤ κ → ∃ (N : Type) (_ : L.Structure N), Nonempty (L.ElementaryEmbedding M N) ∧ Cardinal.mk N = κ)
